advisory_findings.finding: PanZoom cases each retain 352/468/345600 bytes, which accumulate until process shutdown (821 per-test gauges, identical on old and new wheels). Root cause not found. The revised focus check tolerates it by design. Track it as an explicit open item, separate from focus coverage.

Exact equality between the entry gauges and the post-teardown gauges is appropriate for this finite fixture. Masking would need exact cancellation on several gauges at once, and the 823/824 controls are refused even from a non-zero entry reading. The entry reading is taken without a prior gc.collect()/process_events(). Possible later hardening: weak references proving the owned canvases and host are gone, or an in-test reading showing owned bytes were counted. Not required now; changing the test cancels reuse.
The negative control adds a retained canvas after teardown. It proves the gauges notice retained canvases, not a fault inside the fixture's own teardown.
